_comment: Copy to reference-env.config.json (git-ignored). Environment variables override these values.
_comment_bundleDir: H3REF_BUNDLE_DIR. Complete edition folder containing Heroes3.exe, h3maped.exe and Data/.
bundleDir: /home/<user>/.wine/drive_c/Games/Heroes of Might and Magic III Complete
_comment_wineBinary: H3REF_WINE. Wine executable on PATH or absolute path.
_comment_stateDir: H3REF_STATE_DIR. Outside the repo. Default: $XDG_STATE_HOME/h3-reference or ~/.local/state/h3-reference.
_comment_mapSearchDirs: Folders searched for --map file names. Default: [<repo>/public/dev-assets, <bundleDir>/Maps].
_comment_timeouts: Milliseconds. Defaults: still 120000, clipBase 60000, editor 120000, step 30000, lockWait 300000.
